testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the Find feature criteria: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:99:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the Find feature criteria ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active part is open in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user chooses Find from the model browser menu ✔ Then a search criteria dialog opens over the workspace ✔ And its object type list offers Sketches and Features ✔ When the user selects Features and opens the Property list ✔ Then the list offers Name, Note contents, Note title, Suppress status and Type ✔ When the user selects Name and opens the Condition list ✔ Then the list offers any value, begins with, ends with, includes, is exactly and is not ✔ When the user dismisses the list and closes the dialog ✔ Then the model browser and part remain visible
